role_output.MAJOR_MODULES: cmd/lb-control-plane + internal/api — management HTTP and dataplane control server; Apply/validate/revision/snapshot/rollout orchestration. internal/model+revision+snapshot+persistence — desired-state validation, idempotency/revision fencing, canonical digest compile, atomic generation store. internal/rollout+nodes+ops+readiness+retention+recovery+health — quorum prepare/activate, session fences, membership alignment, retention holds, bootstrap CURRENT recovery, health aggregation. dataplane proxy/connection/selector/eligibility/health/drain/prober/control/checkpoint/protocol/status — epoll L4 forwarding, balancing, health/ejection/drain, prepare/activate client, durable checkpoints. tools/lab/backends.py — differentiated loopback backends via bin/lab. config fleet+nodes+desired+scenarios — deterministic inventory and lab desired state.
role_output.PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing only control-plane Apply validation without dataplane eligibility/PROXY/drain leaves TCP contract broken. Repairing activate quorum counting without session/digest fencing still fails reconnect/stale-session cases. Checkpoint load without digest/complete-marker checks accepts torn generations. Lab backend PROXY inspect without matching dataplane header emission fails identity-preservation paths. Local single-node success without live-session quorum semantics fails multi-node prepare/activate.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of coupled core (proxy transfer/PROXY path, eligibility/zone/fail-open, revision Begin/Commit fencing, snapshot digest compile, control prepare/activate, checkpoint save/load_current, or rollout Record phase transitions) collapses observable apply/rollout/proxy/recovery behavior. Removing fleet_simulator.py or most dp-XX JSON duplicates beyond one profile would not erase those behaviors. Reformatting dense C++ to normal line breaks would raise physical LOC without adding logic, confirming compression rather than padding.
